headline: Eagles 24-20 Cowboys: Hurts and Barkley close Week 3 in prime time
whyCareReason: A classic NFC East slugfest ends with Philadelphia stuffing Dallas on fourth down late to seize second place in the division.
teaser: FINAL: Eagles 24, Cowboys 20. Jalen Hurts two total TDs, Saquon Barkley 116 rushing yards. Philadelphia moves to 2-1 as Week 3 concludes.
story:
Why this one matters: Monday Night Football closed Week 3 with the fiercest rivalry in the NFC East, and Philadelphia held firm when it mattered most, winning 24-20 at a raucous Lincoln Financial Field.

Jalen Hurts passed for 240 yards and a score while adding a vintage goal-line rushing touchdown. Saquon Barkley delivered the knockout blow in the fourth quarter, cutting through the Dallas front for an 18-yard touchdown run to cap a 116-yard rushing evening. Nick Sirianni's offense controlled the tempo and won the time-of-possession battle.

Dak Prescott threw for 262 yards and two touchdowns to CeeDee Lamb, rallying Dallas within four points late. But with 1:12 remaining on fourth-and-6 at the Philadelphia 28-yard line, Brandon Graham and Jalen Carter collapsed the pocket, sealing the victory. Philadelphia moves to 2-1 while Dallas slips to 1-2.
stakes: The Eagles secure sole possession of second place in the NFC East at 2-1 and claim early head-to-head advantage over Dallas.
rivalryAngle: Another memorable chapter in football's premier rivalry ends with the midnight green faithful celebrating a prime-time triumph.
